default.title: Morning Glow
default.description: Your pet stretches lazily as the morning sun hits the window. Take a few steps around your room to help it greet the day.

default.title: Trail of Leaves
default.description: Golden leaves swirl ahead of your pet’s paws. Step outside for a short walk and let them follow your path.

default.title: Music Ripple
default.description: A faint tune echoes through your pet’s world. Play a song fully or hum along — the ripples make the air sparkle.

default.title: Creative Pawprints
default.description: Your pet paws at a blank page curiously. Draw, write, or doodle something to leave your mark together.
